# omadafusion_port_profile (Resource)

A switch port profile (Network Config > Switch Port Profiles): the native network, tagged networks and port protections applied to every switch port that uses it. Assign profiles with `omadafusion_switch_port`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omadafusion_lan_network" "devices" { name = "Devices" }
data "omadafusion_lan_network" "voice" { name = "Voice" }

# Access port for printers and other fixed devices, with a tagged voice VLAN
# for a desk phone pass-through.
resource "omadafusion_port_profile" "devices_access" {
  name               = "Devices access"
  native_network_id  = data.omadafusion_lan_network.devices.id
  tagged_network_ids = [data.omadafusion_lan_network.voice.id]
  loopback_detect    = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Profile name.

### Optional

- `eee` (Boolean) Energy Efficient Ethernet.
- `flow_control` (Boolean) 802.3x flow control.
- `lldp_med` (Boolean) Enable LLDP-MED.
- `loopback_detect` (Boolean) Enable port-based loopback detection.
- `native_network_id` (String) LAN network sent untagged. Omit for a tagged-only port.
- `port_isolation` (Boolean) Isolate the port from other isolated ports on the switch.
- `site` (String) Site name or ID. Defaults to the provider `site`. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `spanning_tree` (Boolean) Participate in spanning tree.
- `tagged_network_ids` (Set of String) LAN networks sent tagged.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Port profile ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <id> or <site>/<id>
terraform import omadafusion_port_profile.devices_access Default/64f0c0ffee00000000000001
```
